login.title: Sign in to TCMS
login.body: You will continue to your organization's secure sign-in page.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.body: Your account does not have permission to open this page. Ask your administrator if you need access.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page does not exist or is not available to your account.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: TCMS could not load. Try again in a moment.

errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach TCMS. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.CONFLICT: This item was changed by someone else. It has been refreshed; review it and try again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: This file type is not supported.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.SERVER_ERROR: TCMS had a problem completing this request.
errors.outcomeUnknown: The result is not certain. Check whether the change was saved before trying again.
errors.PRECONDITION_REQUIRED: This change needs the latest version. Reload the page and try again.
errors.POLICY_NOT_EDITABLE: This policy version is published and can no longer be changed.
errors.CLAIM_NOT_EDITABLE: This claim can no longer be changed.
errors.CLAIM_HAS_BLOCKING_FINDINGS: The claim cannot be submitted yet. Fix the items marked as blocking.
errors.TOO_MANY_RECEIPTS: This claim already has the maximum number of receipts.
errors.UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND: The file did not finish uploading. Try again.
errors.RECEIPT_NOT_AVAILABLE: This receipt is not available to view yet.
errors.NO_POLICY_IN_FORCE: No transportation policy is in force yet.

server.EFFECTIVE_DATE_TAKEN: Another published version already starts on this date.
server.EFFECTIVE_DATE_IN_PAST: A new version cannot start in the past.

descriptions.EMPLOYEE: Submit and track their own claims

setup.title: Company setup
setup.intro: Finish these steps so employees can start submitting claims.
setup.ready: Setup is complete. Employees can start submitting claims.

ORGANIZATION.title: Company profile
ORGANIZATION.body: Confirm the legal name, time zone and currency.

ACCESS.title: Access
ACCESS.body: Give people roles such as approver, finance and HR.

EMPLOYEE_SOURCE.title: Employees
EMPLOYEE_SOURCE.body: Add employees so they can sign in and submit claims.

policies.title: Policies
policies.intro: Each published version applies to trips on or after its start date. Published versions cannot be changed; create a new version instead.
policies.immutable: Published {{date}}. This version is locked; create a new version to change the rules.

publishConfirm.title: Publish version {{version}}?
publishConfirm.body: It will apply to trips from {{date}} and cannot be edited afterwards.

hints.effectiveFrom: Trips on or after this day use this version.
hints.perTripLimit: Trips above this are flagged for the reviewer.
hints.receiptRequiredAbove: Trips above this amount need a receipt.
hints.submissionDeadlineDays: Claims for a month must be submitted within this many days after it ends.

claims.title: My claims
claims.saveToAttach: Save the draft to attach receipts.
claims.saveToRecalculate: Save to recalculate the total and checks.
claims.noPolicy: No transportation policy is in force yet, so claims cannot be submitted.

submitConfirm.title: Submit claim {{number}}?
submitConfirm.body: Total {{total}}. You cannot change the claim while it is being reviewed.

deleteConfirm.title: Discard draft {{number}}?
deleteConfirm.body: The draft and its receipts will be removed. This cannot be undone.

submitHint.scanning: Receipts are still being checked. You can submit when they are ready.
submitHint.blocking: Fix the blocking items below before submitting.

codes.NO_POLICY_IN_FORCE: No transportation policy covers this month.
codes.FUTURE_DATE: The trip date is in the future.
codes.DATE_OUTSIDE_PERIOD: The trip date is outside the claim month.
codes.MODE_NOT_ALLOWED: This type of transport is not covered by the policy.
codes.PER_TRIP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Above the per-trip limit of {{limit}}; the reviewer will decide.
codes.RECEIPT_REQUIRED: A receipt is required for trips above {{threshold}}.
codes.RECEIPT_NOT_READY: The attached receipt is not ready yet.
codes.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_RECEIPT: {{fileName}} looks the same as a receipt on {{claimNumber}}. The reviewer will check it.
codes.MONTHLY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The total is above the monthly limit of {{limit}}; the reviewer will decide.
codes.SUBMISSION_DEADLINE_PASSED: The deadline for this month was {{deadline}}.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.limits: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to {{size}} MB each, {{count}} per claim.

removeConfirm.title: Remove {{fileName}}?
removeConfirm.body: Trips using this receipt will no longer have one.

receipts.storageFailed: The upload did not complete. Try again.

precheck.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Not attached: this file type is not accepted.
precheck.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: Not attached: the file is too large.
precheck.TOO_MANY_RECEIPTS: Not attached: the claim already has the maximum number of receipts.

rejection.MALWARE_DETECTED: Rejected: the file failed the security scan.
rejection.CONTENT_TYPE_MISMATCH: Rejected: the file content does not match its type.

receipts.duplicate: Same file as a receipt on {{claimNumber}}; the reviewer will check it.
receipts.scanningHint: The file is being checked. It can be viewed once it is ready.
